one_liners: UN High Seas Treaty enters into force on Jan 17, 2026 — first legally binding treaty for oceans beyond national jurisdiction, ratified by 60+ countries.
India's first sleeper Vande Bharat Express flagged off on Jan 17 — Howrah–Kamakhya (Guwahati), flagged off from Malda Town in West Bengal.
